## What changed

<!-- One or two sentences. Example: adds a "Webhook retries" template with the GTA theme. -->

## Type

- [ ] New template (`templates/<theme>/<slug>.json`)
- [ ] New theme (`themes/<id>.json`)
- [ ] Fix / improvement to an existing file
- [ ] Tooling or docs

## Checklist

- [ ] I ran `npm run check` and it passes.
- [ ] I ran `npm run manifest` and committed `manifest.json`.
- [ ] The file follows the folder convention (template theme = folder name, file name = slug).
- [ ] The diagram has at least 2 nodes and 1 step, and all edge/step references exist.
- [ ] New themes use a unique id (not one of the six built-ins) and a single font family per field.
- [ ] I own this content and agree to publish it under the MIT license.
- [ ] No tokens, keys, personal data or external assets are included.
